text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, May 5 - COAL - NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 1 vessel loading, 7 waiting, 22 due by 20/5. 7 Days delay expected.
Dykes 4+5 - 2 Vessels loading, 6 waiting, 28 due by 21/5. 5-6 Days delay expected.
Port Kembla - Two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 15 due by 1/7. No delays.
May 6 - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 6 vessels due by 22/5. No delays.
Hay Point - Two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 13 due by 24/5. 1 Day delay expected.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 14 due by 21/5. 1 Day delay.
Gladstone - Dredging of outer harbour channel will commence mid-May and is expected to be completed at the end of July/early August. Minimum sailing draft will decrease from 16.4-17.0 metres.
R.G. Tanna - 23 Vessels due by 25/5. 1 Day delay expected.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel loading, 4 due by 4/6. No delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 2 vessels due by 10/5. No delays.

IRON ORE - May 5 - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to occasional shortage of Mt. Newman lump/fines and Yandi fines, vessels may experience delays to berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. Industrial action continues and power still restricted at some Western Australian ports. However, there is little effect at present on berthing/loading of iron ore vessels. Berth 1 - Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 8 due by 14/5. B Berth - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 7 due by 13/5, 2 others due by 17/5, no eta received.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 1 Vessel loading.
Dampier - Parker Point - Maintenance shutdown 18-23 May. One vessel loading, 7 anchored.
East Intercourse Island - 1 Vessel loading, 6 anchored.
Dampier line-up - 20 Vessels due by 19/5 of which 10 for Parker Point, 10 for East Intercourse Island.
Port Walcott - 14 Vessels due by 30/5. Maintenance shutdown from C.A. 22-26/5.
GRAIN, May 7 - QUEENSLAND - Mackay, Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - Two vessels due by 15/5, both to load wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Six vessels due by 25/5 of which 5 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load canola. 7 Vessels due during May of which 6 to load wheat, 1 tba. Berthing programme based on grade of cargo received by rail.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 8 due by 27/5 of which 6 to load wheat, 1 canola/soya, 1 malt/barley.
Portland - One vessel loading wheat. 10 Vessels due by 30/5 of which 4 to load peas, 1 canola, 5 wheat.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie, Thevenard, Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Adelaide - One vessel due 13/5 to load wheat.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading lupins, 1 due 29/5 to load wheat.
Wallaroo - One vessel waiting to load barley, 3 due by 25/5 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 peas.
Port Giles - One vessel due 12/5 to load barley.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Three vessels loading wheat, 5 waiting to load of which 3 wheat, 2 lupins. 1 Vessel due 19/5 to load wheat.
Kwinana - Two vessels loading wheat, 4 waiting to load of which 3 wheat, 1 lupins. 11 Due by 23/5 of which 9 to load wheat, 1 barley, 1 lupins.
Albany - One loading wheat.
Esperance - Two due by 21/5, both to load barley.
